issues: Below the project feasibility target of 100 independent reference-event groups; current acquisition groups are conservative mergers, not verified incidents.
Below the project feasibility target of 10,000 tiles; repeated/overlapping crops do not replace independent events.
Very few positive training labels; increasing epochs cannot supply missing fire diversity. The 1,000-label flag is an investigation heuristic, not a sufficiency threshold.
Dataset is not forest-only; prior land-cover context is required for that claim.
acceptance: Use a frozen independent test to demonstrate better reference detection than MODIS at matched false-alarm rate, calibration and acceptable region/day-night behavior. Pixel counts alone do not establish usefulness.
